Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner provided the wrong IMDb URL (tt0377109, which is The Ring Two) when intending to open Lemony Snicket’s A Series of Unfortunate Events (tt0339291). This sent the investigation to an unrelated film and introduced confusion. The Planner later compounded this by incorrectly asserting Barry Sonnenfeld as the director based on a misleading search snippet, risking the wrong final answer instead of the correct director, Brad Silberling.
